metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T03 (TRL 7) completes in 2 years which is plausible, and T01/T05 (TRL 6) get 2 years each which is tight but workable; however T02 (TRL 5) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1) despite needing to advance from TRL 5 with high uncertainty, making it effectively infeasible.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy expects lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolios, but the portfolio is dominated by mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 6-7), with only T02 at TRL 5 providing genuine frontier exploration; the portfolio leans more toward commercialization readiness than true technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no discernible evidence of competitor positioning analysis, differentiation strategy, or timing design relative to competitive threats; technology selections appear driven by internal dependency logic rather than competitive gap exploitation or preemption strategy.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도 strategy, technologies should complete 1-2 years BEFORE the market boom to achieve preemption; T03 completes 1 year early (good), but T01 and T05 complete 2.75 years AFTER their boom windows, and T02 completes 1.5 years after its boom, representing systematic late-arrival rather than preemption.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (distributed training, LLM collaboration, inference acceleration, 3D generation) cover active patent and market growth areas in the AI/LLM domain, suggesting some convergence awareness, but the selection rationale does not demonstrate deliberate targeting of patent-market convergence zones.

strengths: Dependency chain is logically sound with T03 as a foundational enabler for downstream technologies, and zero dependency violations indicate disciplined sequencing
Budget utilization is exact at 100% with no overrun, demonstrating tight financial planning discipline
weaknesses: T01 and T05 complete 2.75 years after their respective market boom windows (2027-Q2), meaning the organization will miss peak market opportunity for two of its three Strategic-tier investments
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성) has a zero-duration development window and low executability score (2.0), making it a non-functional roadmap entry rather than a credible development plan
missing_technologies: Lower-TRL foundation model architecture research (TRL 2-4) to genuinely embody 기술선도 strategy
Multi-agent coordination framework or orchestration layer technology to better address the 'multi-agent (full)' scenario
Safety/alignment research technology appropriate for frontier model leadership positioning
investment_issues: All three core technologies (T03, T01, T05) are assigned Strategic tier with urgency=5, yet the timeline does not reflect urgency — T01 and T05 start only after T03 completes in 2028, suggesting urgency scores are not translating into accelerated parallel development
T02 receives High tier investment despite executability=2.0 and a zero-duration timeline, representing potential capital misallocation on an effectively unplanned technology
timing_issues: LLM 기반 컨텍스트 인식 협업 and 대규모 모델 추론 가속화 both complete in 2030-Q1, which is 2.75 years after their 2027-Q2 boom — the organization will enter a post-peak market as a late follower, undermining leadership claims
The sequential dependency structure (T03 → T01/T05 → T02) forces all downstream work to start in 2028-Q1, leaving no buffer to accelerate delivery for early-boom technologies
